_comment: The n8n MCP server for an agent running this profile. Merge into config.yaml under mcp_servers. The server is n8n's own (Settings > MCP in n8n 1.11x and later); it speaks HTTP, so no local command is needed.

n8n._note: Reads are free. update_workflow, publish_workflow, unpublish_workflow and execute_workflow stay allowed but are approval-gated by the n8n-workflow-ops skill. Archiving and restoring an old version are denied: an agent that can roll a live workflow back to last month is an agent that will, once. A human does those in the UI.

_env.N8N_API_KEY: REPLACE_WITH_REST_API_KEY (n8n > Settings > n8n API), read scope is enough for the health job
